summary: Select Water Solutions filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Select Water Holdings priced $900 million of 7.625% senior notes due 2034 in a Rule 144A/Reg S private placement via J.P. Morgan and BofA, upsized from $800 million at par for about $882.6 million net proceeds, closing expected October 21, 2026. Proceeds, with cash on hand, fund part of the previously announced Pilot Water Solutions acquisition, repay the term loan and revolver, and cover fees. The offering is not contingent on that acquisition. Watch leverage and deal-financing overhang ahead of the Pilot Water close.
